instructions.question: Is this string shown to end users in the interface, so that it should be translated?
instructions.note: `item` is one string found in source code. `context` gives the file, the line and where the string sits: an element, an attribute, a call or an object key.

criteria.true: The string is text a person reads in the interface: a label, button, heading, paragraph, message, placeholder, tooltip, alt text or accessible name, in words meant for people.
criteria.false: The string is technical or has nothing to translate: an identifier, key, class name, path, URL, query, command, pattern, format, event name, code, a number or unit, a version, a brand or product name, text made only of values filled in at run time, or a log, debug or test message that people never see.
